title: Nice bin/price outrageous
text: Nice bin/price outrageous. Nice and big bin purchased to replace one that we’ve had for sometime that cracked. It arrived clean and I appreciated that tremendously. The only problem is it’s just way overpriced. Twice as much as the same one at another store. I thought about sending it back, but just figured, oh well. Kept them both. They’re great for storing things like king size pillows and other bedding. Or when transporting a bunch of stuff from kitchen to kitchen.
